sentences.text: Linux -LRB- pronounced -LSB- - en audio = Linus-linux .

oggˈlɪnəks -RSB- or , less frequently , -LSB- ˈlaɪnəks -RSB- -RRB- is a Unix-like computer operating system assembled under the model of free and open-source software development and distribution .	Unix-like	Unix-like	open-source	open-source	operating system	operating system	free and open-source software	free and open-source software	software	software

The defining component of Linux is the Linux kernel , an operating system kernel first released on September 17 , 1991 by Linus Torvalds .	Linux kernel	Linux kernel	Linus Torvalds	Linus Torvalds	operating system	operating system	operating system kernel	Kernel (computing)

The Free Software Foundation uses the name GNU/Linux to describe the operating system , which has led to some controversy .	GNU	GNU	operating system	operating system	Free Software Foundation	Free Software Foundation	controversy	GNU/Linux naming controversy

Linux was originally developed for personal computers based on the Intel x86 architecture , but has since been ported to more platforms than any other operating system .	x86	x86	operating system	operating system	Intel x86	Intel x86	ported	porting	platforms	computer hardware platforms

Because of the dominance of Android on smartphones , Linux has the largest installed base of all general-purpose operating systems .	Android	Android (operating system)	largest	Usage share of operating systems	installed base	installed base

Linux is also the leading operating system on servers and other big iron systems such as mainframe computers , and is used on 99.6 % of the TOP500 supercomputers .	servers	server (computing)	operating system	operating system	big iron	big iron	TOP500	TOP500
It is used by around 2.3 % of desktop computers .

The Chromebook , which runs the Linux kernel-based Chrome OS , dominates the US K -- 12 education market and represents nearly 20 % of the sub - $ 300 notebook sales in the US .	Linux kernel	Linux kernel	Chromebook	Chromebook	notebook	notebook
Linux also runs on embedded systems -- devices whose operating system is typically built into the firmware and is highly tailored to the system .	operating system	operating system	firmware	firmware

This includes TiVo and similar DVR devices , network routers , facility automation controls , televisions , video game consoles and smartwatches .	TiVo	TiVo	DVR	Digital video recorder	routers	router (computing)
Many smartphones and tablet computers run Android and other Linux derivatives .	Android	Android (operating system)

The development of Linux is one of the most prominent examples of free and open-source software collaboration .	open-source	open-source	free and open-source software	free and open-source software	software	software

The underlying source code may be used , modified and distributedcommercially or non-commerciallyby anyone under the terms of its respective licenses , such as the GNU General Public License .	GNU	GNU	source code	source code	GNU General Public License	GNU General Public License

Typically , Linux is packaged in a form known as a Linux distribution -LRB- or distro for short -RRB- for both desktop and server use .	packaged	Package management system	Linux distribution	Linux distribution

Some of the most popular mainstream Linux distributions are Arch Linux , CentOS , Debian , Fedora , Gentoo Linux , Linux Mint , Mageia , openSUSE and Ubuntu , together with commercial distributions such as Red Hat Enterprise Linux and SUSE Linux Enterprise Server .	Arch Linux	Arch Linux	CentOS	CentOS	Debian	Debian	Fedora	Fedora (operating system)	Gentoo Linux	Gentoo Linux	Linux Mint	Linux Mint	Mageia	Mageia	openSUSE	openSUSE	Ubuntu	Ubuntu (operating system)	Red Hat Enterprise Linux	Red Hat Enterprise Linux	SUSE Linux Enterprise Server	SUSE Linux Enterprise Server

Distributions include the Linux kernel , supporting utilities and libraries , many of which are provided by the GNU Project , and usually a large amount of application software to fulfil the distribution 's intended use .	Linux kernel	Linux kernel	GNU	GNU	software	software	utilities	System software	libraries	library (computer science)	GNU Project	GNU Project

Desktop Linux distributions include a windowing system , such as X11 , Mir or a Wayland implementation , and an accompanying desktop environment such as GNOME or the KDE Software Compilation ; some distributions may also include a less resource-intensive desktop , such as LXDE or Xfce .	X11	X11	Mir	Mir (software)	Wayland	Wayland (display server protocol)	desktop environment	desktop environment	GNOME	GNOME	KDE Software Compilation	KDE Software Compilation	LXDE	LXDE	Xfce	Xfce

Distributions intended to run on servers may omit all graphical environments from the standard install , and instead include other software to set up and operate a solution stack such as LAMP .	servers	server (computing)	software	software	solution stack	solution stack	LAMP	LAMP (software bundle)
Because Linux is freely redistributable , anyone may create a distribution for any intended use .
